content.what_it_is: STATISTICS는 전역 격자 상태를 순회해 질량 체적, 에너지, 수면·속도 극값, 최대 합성속도 위치의 중력파 속도를 계산하고(L69-L115), PARALLEL 빌드에서는 MPI_ALLREDUCE로 전역화한 뒤 화면과 unit 3에 통계를 쓰며(L117-L169), 각 출력량을 CHECK_STATISTICS에 넘겨 NaN이면 병렬 중단 또는 STOP을 수행한다(L175-L210).

calls: CHECK_STATISTICS calls for ten reported quantities @L175-L184
unresolved: L107-L110 bind Fr to the cell that produces the local UTotalMax, but PARALLEL reductions independently take MAX of UTotalMax at L130 and Fr at L132 before UTotalMax/Fr is reported and checked at L148, L160, and L183; different ranks can supply the two maxima, so the quotient can lose the intended speed/depth pairing.

MassVolume is gated by MASK>0 at L80-L82 and L88-L90, while Energy is accumulated outside those IF blocks at L84-L86 and L91-L93; inactive or dry cells can therefore contribute to Energy unless their H/U/V values are guaranteed neutral elsewhere.

MaxEta, MinEta, MaxU, and MaxV use unmasked rectangular MAXVAL/MINVAL ranges at L98-L101, whereas the maximum-speed/Froude scan explicitly requires MASK>ZERO at L106; extrema may therefore come from cells excluded from the latter statistic.
MassVolume0 at L60 and saved FirstCallStatistics at L61-L62 have no subsequent read or assignment through EOF L215, consistent with incomplete or copied-out first-call baseline logic.
